text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning a deploy for orbit-service tonight at 22:00 PT. No DB migrations in this change but includes a small routing toggle. Window ~30m. Need owners for canary, smoke, rollback, and infra watch. Please ack and add any checks you want on the runbook.

Meera: I can own smoke + telemetry. Will run smoke checklist and post results.

Sam: I'll be rollback owner. Confirmed no schema changes? If anything looks off I can roll back to v3.18.

Liz-Infra: Liz-Infra here — infra confirmed: no DB/schema changes, no infra rollout needed. I'll be on watch for autoscaling and network alerts during window. Add me to the escalation ping.

Jordan: Canary plan: 5% for first 10m, then 25% for next 10m if metrics are green. Abort thresholds: error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 300ms sustained for 3 mins.

Jen-QA: I'll run quick E2E flows (auth, upload, inference path). Posting the quick smoke checklist below so Meera and I can tick things off:

```
SMOKE CHECKLIST — orbit-service deploy
- Health endpoints (200): /health, /ready
- Auth flow: login, token refresh
- Core write path: small upload + process (succeeds, status 200)
- Inference happy path: sample prompt -> valid output
- Telemetry: traces show request spans, no missing spans
- Logs: no new Fatal/Exception stacktraces
- Canary metrics: success rate >= 99.5%, p95 latency < 300ms
- Rollback sanity: rollback job tested in staging, verified db-safe
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued — job_id=deploy-orbit-2117530000, scheduled=22:00 PT. Notified owners: @Meera @Sam @Jordan @Liz-Infra @Jen-QA.

Alex: Great — final ack check: Meera (smoke), Sam (rollback), Jordan (canary), Liz-Infra (infra watch), Jen-QA (smoke runs). Please respond with :thumbsup: to confirm.

Meera: :thumbsup: I'll post results in this thread as I run them.

Sam: :thumbsup: standing by for rollback if needed.

Jordan: :thumbsup: Canary config ok on my side.

Liz-Infra: :thumbsup: I'll monitor autoscale and network; will escalate to infra pager if anything spikes.

Jen-QA: :thumbsup: starting smoke at T-10. Will update with pass/fail and logs.

Alex: Thanks everyone — will trigger at 22:00 PT. If anyone needs to opt out, speak up now.
